## AI Control Tower — https://www.servicenow.com/docs/r/release-notes/ai-control-tower-rn.html
**UNCHANGED this scan.** Newest is still **Australia Patch 4**, same feature set captured 2026-08-14:
- Redesigned AI Control Tower with natural-language search and task completion
- Activity Center; recommendations and AI insights
- Quality and safety monitoring with automated scoring and trend analysis
- ServiceNow Otto premium chat integration with unified search
- **Kill switch protocol** — AI agent containment for AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI and ServiceNow
- **Agent map visualization** — AI models, **MCP servers**, providers and workflows  [rep. 08-14]
- **AI asset deduplication**                                                        [rep. 08-14]
- Post-runtime security metrics configured by default; asset state at creation;
  Risk & Compliance posture review; enhanced AWS/GCP/Microsoft connectors
Patch 3: SB 53 and Colorado AI Act frameworks; AI record type label updates.
Patch 2: **Microsoft Agent 365 publishing for ServiceNow agents**; Databricks Service Graph Connector.
Patch 1: customizable AI asset security scoring; new LLM/agent security metrics; agentic AI system
lifecycle management; expanded AI asset association.
Early availability: AI connections framework via Service Graph Connectors; managed/unmanaged asset
categorization; MCP Global Clients and Catalog.

## Service Graph Connector versions — unchanged, reported 2026-08-14
Anthropic **v2.0.7** (discovers models, tracks PER-USER costs); Microsoft (unified Azure ML config,
certificate-based auth); Amazon (single credential page, automatic key rotation); GCP Vertex AI
**v1.2.4, renamed "AI Connector for Google"** (name-match detection hazard); Databricks (discovers
AND **imports** AI agents).

## Standing facts
- **AI Gateway is DEPRECATED in Australia and no longer supported** (legacy MCP client-server
  interactions remain visible through it). The "AI Gateway GA" watch is CLOSED as superseded.
- **MCP Server Console** (plugin `sn_mcp_server`, v1.3) turns a ServiceNow instance into a governed
  MCP server exposing Subflows, Actions, REST APIs, Knowledge Graphs and Now Assist skills as tools,
  with embedded OAuth client registration and third-party IDP support. Reported 2026-08-10.
- Machine Identity Console (Zurich, not Australia) is the identity substrate MCP Server Console
  depends on. Outside Zenity's coverage — context only.
